title: Rotating a layer that already has a transform updates live while you drag
goal: Turning a layer with the rotate tool or its rotate handle should show the turn live, every frame, even when the layer already carries a transform (a 3D tilt or depth, a scale, a key, a group's transform). Today on such a layer the picture does not follow the drag and only jumps to the result on release.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-12): "If i have a transform on an object, and then i use the rotate tool, it does not live update."

Suspect from code reading, not confirmed: the 3D handle drag has its own live preview that puts the in-flight turn3D on the layer (CanvasDisplay.swift:1135 'shown.updateLayer(id: drag.layerID) { $0.turn3D = drag.turn }'), but the 2D rotate drag may draw its in-flight preview through a path (a cached sprite or a 2D-only transform) that does not compose with turn3D or other transforms, so the canvas stays put until commit. 2.5D shipped in layers-can-turn-about-x-and-y-and-move-in-depth and tilt-flip-and-push-layers-in-depth-from-the-canv (2026-10-11). Check every in-flight drag preview (move, resize, rotate) against layers with turn3D.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults: give a text layer and a picture a 3D tilt (Rotation Y 30), then rotate each with the rotate tool and with the rotate handle; also try a layer with scale, one with position keys, one inside a rotated group; record in the audit which ones do not update live and what the canvas shows during the drag

Rotating any layer, whatever transform it already has, updates the canvas every frame of the drag at the same frame rate as rotating a plain layer (MEASURED frames per second during a 2 s drag, plain vs tilted), and the in-flight picture matches the committed result exactly on release (no jump; pixel diff at release under 1%)
Moving and resizing a transformed layer are checked the same way and fixed if they show the same fault
The selection outline and handles follow the projected (tilted) shape during the drag
A walk tilts a layer in 3D, rotates it by dragging, and photographs mid-drag frames that must differ from the start frame
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced at Next defaults on the sample recording with a new spaceHandle reading (picture changes per move, held vs landed diff). BEFORE: plain rectangle 1 of 120 moves changed (0 pictures/s); rectangle tilted Y 30: 1 of 120 (0/s); tilted title 120/120 (53/s, text never used the sprite); rectangle with a Position key 120/120 (53/s, keyed layers never used it). The mid-turn capture shows the outline turned and the picture still: the user's report, and not only for transformed layers.

Cause: since June 2026 (f73bfacd) CanvasDisplay.previewedFrame had no case for a transform drag, so the floated sprite was hidden for turns, while EditorState.previewLayerTransform returned early whenever a sprite existed. Once the sprite render landed (~100ms in) nothing redrew until mouse-up. Also beginLayerDrag sprited layers drawn in space: the sprite is a flat render, so a tilted layer moved untilted.

Fix (a84977bd): previewLayerTransform discards the sprite and re-renders per move (a sprite would also float over layers above, turn about the wrong pivot for a motion-hung layer, and is wrong for 3D). beginLayerDrag skips the sprite when drawnMap(of:) != nil, so moves/resizes of a tilted layer re-render and keep the tilt. The in-space chrome map carries transformDrag.transform so the outline/handles follow the tilted card mid-turn. AFTER: every case 117-120 of 120 moves, 52-53 pictures/s, 0.00% held-vs-landed; 51/s on a 4000x3000 picture. 13 related walks green; Scripts/test.sh 12785 tests passed.

Left rough (log only): spriteDeltaTransform and transformHold in CanvasDisplay are now unreachable for turns (the sprite is always discarded first); harmless, kept. Unconfirmed: after a knob turn of a group a click computed onto a piece picked the recording; my coordinate mapping was not verified and a turnKnob-turned group picks its piece fine, so not filed. Knob angle on a tilted layer is read in the flat canvas plane (audit rough, unmeasured). Filed p2 open question find-out-whether-moving-a-layer-that-sits-under.

Turning a layer on its knob now redraws the picture on every move for plain, 3D-tilted, title, keyed, grouped and in-group layers (was 0 pictures/s on plain and tilted, now 52-53/s, 51/s on 4000x3000, 0.00% jump on release); tilted layers keep their tilt while moved; 3D outline follows the turn. Commit a84977bd. Verified by rotate-a-tilted-layer-live-walk (green, no flags) plus 13 related walks and Scripts/test.sh. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-12-rotate-live.json.
